constraints.def: CHECK (((unobserved_recent IS NULL) OR ((period)::text = '1y'::text) OR (((period)::text = '3y'::text) AND (unobserved_recent = 0)) OR (((period)::text = '5y'::text) AND (unobserved_recent = 0) AND (unobserved_stale = 0))))
